CustomField.formula:
CASE( TEXT($User.LanguageLocaleKey),
/* --------- ENGLISH --------- */ "en_US", IF( ISPICKVAL(c_Requiere_Auditoria__c, "Si") && AuditoriaAprobada__c, IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_green.gif", "Approved") & " Approved",
IF( ISPICKVAL(c_Requiere_Auditoria__c, "Si") && NOT(AuditoriaAprobada__c), IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_yellow.gif", "Pending") & " Pending",
"Not required" ) ),
/* --------- SPANISH (DEFAULT) --------- */ IF( ISPICKVAL(c_Requiere_Auditoria__c, "Si") && AuditoriaAprobada__c, IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_green.gif", "Aprobada") & " Aprobada",
IF( ISPICKVAL(c_Requiere_Auditoria__c, "Si") && NOT(AuditoriaAprobada__c), IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_yellow.gif", "Pendiente") & " Pendiente",
"No requiere" ) ) )
CustomField.label: Indicador Auditoría
